record.name: Ice Cold Killers
record.summary: Youngstown, Ohio, 2017; Shannon Graves, age 28, went missing under mysterious circumstances. Months later, her partially dissected remains were discovered stuffed into a chest freezer in the basement of a rental home. Who put her there, and why did they store the freezer in someone else's basement? Why was she murdered so cruelly and discarded so heinously? In the end, the three culprits responsible for her disappearance and murder were Shannon's former boyfriend, Arturo Novoa, Arturo's current girlfriend, Katrina Layton, and Arturo's friend, Andrew Herrmann. Novoa, Layton and Herrmann were all arrested and convicted of various crimes regarding the death of Shannon Graves. They were all sentenced to varying amounts of time in prison.

record.name: Murder on Repeat
record.summary: In 2001, Barbara Purcell was found murdered in her basement. Her husband Willard was convicted in 2003 and died in prison in 2015. The case revealed links to his first wife Crystal's 1987 basement stair death in Rockford.

record.name: Killer in the New Neighborhood
record.summary: In 1978, a shocking murder in broad daylight terrifies a small Illinois town. The brutal crime goes unsolved for years, until an elite team of law enforcement investigators uses cutting-edge technology to dig up new clues and lay a cunning trap to catch a killer.

record.name: Chase and Lies
record.summary: When 32-year-old Adam Chase goes missing, police comb the woods and fields of Ontario County, New York, but come up with nothing. Adam's disappearance takes a months-long efforts of a private investigator to at last reveal the truth and Adam's terrifying fate.

record.name: Deadly Invitation
record.summary: In 1999, a killer brutally murders an activist and member of the gay community Dennis Dolinger in the basement of his Washington, DC, home. With DNA technology in its infancy, the race is on to find the culprit before they strike again.

record.name: Missing Means Murder
record.summary: A man vanishes from a small town, leaving behind a trail of strange clues that stumps law enforcement detectives and leads the missing man's neighbors to believe that a deadly imposter is living among them. When the man's body is found, the truth is more shocking than anyone imagined.

record.name: Living the Dream Boat
record.summary: When Lori becomes the star of The Dream Boat to find her soulmate, a desperate Bobby goes undercover as a contestant to win her back from a "perfect" rival suitor.

record.name: Trend Fretter/This Is My Fight Song
Emotional Rollercoaster
record.summary: When the Loud family gets trapped upside down on a malfunctioning roller coaster at Dairyland, they must rely on their memories of past wild adventures to stay calm and find a way down.
